- Set aside ten minutes to practice the obedience this reflection emphasized instead of postponing it.
section_previews_by_key.12:prayer: Father, thank You for speaking clearly in Colossians 4:15-18. In this passage You bring ordinary ministry faithfulness in the fellowship of the gospel into the open through The part read my letter that is coming from Laodicea. Lord, keep us from reading these words as distant history only, and press them into our ordinary obedience today. Where we resist the truth highlighted in this reflection, bring repentance and renewed trust. Keep us near Your word, and do not let ordinary pressure turn us away from humble obedience. Holy Spirit, take what we have seen in the exposition and turn it into worship instead of mere information. Teach us to remember that Colossians 4:15-18 opens with a scene marked by ordinary ministry faithfulness in the fellowship of the gospel. Guard our speech from haste, our work from pride, and our choices from whatever would pull us away from faithful response instead of vague admiration. Help us practice the obedience this day requires with humility as we pursue steady faithfulness in ordinary ministry roles while honoring the cost of gospel service. Amen.
